of Film & Photography
home.usp.description: Walking Weddings brings together wedding film and photography into a singular narrative of your day. From the intimate ceremony to the joyful celebration — we capture every moment from two perspectives, perfectly in tune, from one team. At home in Vienna, on the road for weddings across Europe and worldwide.
home.founders.title:
Meet the
Founders
home.founders.intro: We are Kiran & Ian — friends since our school days, today a perfectly attuned duo for wedding photography & film.
home.founders.bio: Our bond shapes our work: it creates trust, calm, and an atmosphere in which you can simply be yourselves. As hybrid photographers, we capture your story from two perspectives — in timeless images and moving films.
home.gallery.quote: “Among the photographs are true works of art. We would recommend Ian & Kiran to anyone without a moment's hesitation.”
home.testimonial1.quote: “We couldn't be happier with Ian & Kiran as our wedding photographers! From the very beginning, the two of them took an incredible amount of time for us. They embraced all of our wishes and, with their calm, professional manner, created a wonderful atmosphere. The results speak for themselves: among the photographs are true works of art. We would recommend Ian & Kiran without hesitation to anyone who wants not just photos, but real memories for a lifetime.”
home.testimonial1.author: — Stephanie & Sebastian
home.testimonial2.quote: “We are endlessly grateful that we chose Walking Weddings for our wedding. From the very first planning conversation to the big day, they accompanied us beautifully. Their distinctive style is incomparable, and the result delighted us completely. You feel their heart and passion in every single moment. We can only recommend Walking Weddings with all our hearts.”
home.testimonial2.author: — Savitha & Tony
home.testimonial3.quote: “We had an incredibly wonderful pre-wedding shoot with the two of them in Rome, and we were equally thrilled with their work over our wedding weekend in Italy! They are relaxed and easy-going with people, so that moments and emotions are captured naturally and you simply have fun with them. We can recommend them to absolutely anyone!”

meta.about.title: About — Wedding Photographers, Vienna & Europe | Walking Weddings
meta.about.desc: Meet the team behind Walking Weddings — your wedding photography and film duo from Vienna, shooting across Europe.
about.hero.tagline: An atelier for wedding imagery. Vienna, since 2024 — travelling across Europe.
about.spread.caption: The studio, Vienna.
about.spread.title:
Two perspectives.
One story.
about.spread.lede: Kiran and Ian — photographers and filmmakers from Vienna. Hybrid, close friends, both behind the camera the moment you say I do.
about.spread.quote: “One day. Two perspectives. Images that endure — and films that move like memory itself.”
about.kiran.body: He came to weddings by way of fashion and food photography — and stayed, because the people in front of his lens never let him go. Ever since, Kiran has told love stories in image and motion: warm, unhurried, with a fine instinct for the fleeting moment between two glances.
about.kiran.quote: “I don't capture the day. I capture how it feels.”
about.ian.body: Once a sceptic of wedding photography — until Kiran captured his own wedding and showed him the magic within it. Today: self-taught, an observer, a builder of trust. Ian creates the kind of ease that lets the camera recede into the background — so your attention stays wholly with one another. Those are precisely the moments he captures.
about.ian.quote: “The finest images come the moment no one is thinking about the camera anymore.”
about.closing.title:
Tell us
your story.

meta.guide.title: Your Wedding Guide — Walking Weddings
meta.guide.desc: Your wedding guide from Walking Weddings — five expert tips for photo and film to make your 2027 wedding unforgettable.
guide.hero.headline: Your Roadmap to the 2027 Wedding
guide.hero.sub: Tips from your photo & film experts
guide.intro.text: Congratulations! You've decided to say "I do" in 2027. It may still feel far off, but the most beautiful stories begin with relaxed planning. Here are our five expert tips to make your wedding images and film as unique as the two of you.
guide.tip1.title: The Foundation: Timing Is Everything
guide.tip1.body: The most sought-after venues and vendors are often booked 18 to 24 months in advance. By securing your 2027 date now, you keep the freedom to choose — without compromising on your style.
guide.tip2.title: Style Check: Photo vs. Film
guide.tip2.body: A photograph captures the moment; a film captures the emotion and the sound. Decide early whether you'd prefer a pure documentary approach or a "cinematic short film" that tells the story of your wedding like a Hollywood epic. The two should always be in harmony.
guide.tip3.title: The Chemistry Has to Be Right
guide.tip3.body: Your photographer and videographer are the vendors closest to you on your wedding day. When choosing, look beyond the portfolio and trust your instinct at that first meeting. Only when you feel at ease do authentic, unposed images emerge.
guide.tip4.title: Budget Security Through Early Booking
guide.tip4.body: Prices across the wedding industry adjust year on year. A major advantage for 2027 couples: book now and you'll often lock in today's rates, protecting yourselves from price increases in the years to come.
guide.tip5.title: Make the Most of the Golden Light
guide.tip5.body: Be sure to plan your couple's portraits around the "golden hour" — just before sunset. That soft light creates magical images no flash in the world could ever recreate. We'd be delighted to help you with the timing!
